claims.statement: Pinned iteration guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES; iteration field assigns items to repeating time blocks, allows breaks and individual name/date edits. Group/sort/timeline visualization is not enforcement of deadlines or completion.

Iteration filters accept name and @current/@previous/@next with comparison/range operators. Source does not specify timezone, overlap or gap resolution or exact boundary inclusivity; independently test intended calendar profile.

New field creates three iterations automatically, starts today unless changed and permits duration in days/weeks. No minimum/maximum duration or recurring auto-generation guarantee specified; historical defaults are not universal policy.

Additional iterations can reuse duration or customize start/duration before Save changes. Date-range edit selects start/end and Apply then saves; actual identity, overlaps and dependent scheduling effects require verification.

Iteration deletion is optional trash action followed by Save changes. Source does not establish assigned-item behavior, undo or restoration; deletion of iteration is not demonstrated deletion of project items or repository issues.

Break communicates time away and defaults to most recently created iteration duration, not necessarily neighboring iteration. Source does not specify automatic shifting of later iterations or item reassignment; no effect inferred.

Bulk move requires view grouped by iteration, group menu, target and confirmation; all items in group update to target. Exact item identity, filtered/hidden scope and concurrent changes are not defined; proposed safe move requires observed affected-item diff.

Moving unfinished work is described as scheduling use case, not acceptance of work as completed or verification of sprint success. Target iteration selection must not implicitly change underlying issue closure or user authorization.

New-field/settings reusables are navigation; linked roadmap/filter/table pages are separate review. No iteration created, renamed, deleted, break inserted or item moved. All claims reference-only, with no accepted policy, rights clearance or native receipt.
